name: detail-D-opening_perimeter-GARDEN_FRAMED_2X6
notes: • D-B-SUNKEN: seat, support and membrane bonds per K4-K6.
• Water plane: the 60 mil waterproofing. Opening membranes lap onto it, shingle-fashion.
• Veneer arches are self-supporting, under the porch: no lintel, no head flashing (IRC R703.8.5).
• WIN-B-SAUNA is 3'-8" above the court, clear of the flood line. Liner vapour return seals inside.
K1  Buck through the 6" foam to the waterproofing, sealed to it.
K2  Head: membrane band on the buck, lapped under the waterproofing above. Jamb bands lap over the sill pan.
K3  Sill pan sloped 1/4"/ft, with back dam and end dams 6" up the jambs, lapped over the waterproofing below.
K4  D-B-SUNKEN: concrete curb with overflow drainage and sump pump; door is specified for standard rain exposure, not as a flood barrier.
K5  D-B-SUNKEN: keep pan outlet open; confirm seat, sealant and drainage with the installed door and pan instructions.
K6  D-B-SUNKEN: the blind curb-skin recess clears the approach (no sill extender); verify field membrane bonds.
K7  Veneer cavity: 4" clear air. Keep the base-course weeps open; they drain it after the court drains.
